u2/clean-10.description: How much new high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity will the three main producers (SK Hynix, Micron, Samsung) bring online, and will the HBM shortage keep memory prices at record highs through late 2027 — a supply and input-cost constraint on NVIDIA's GPU shipments?
